behavior.analyticsSample: 1 in 100 visitors; load_test=true; at most 500 events

caveats: Visitor counts are total gradually arriving sessions, not simultaneous users.
Protocol-level browsing model; no browser rendering/JS cost is benchmarked.
Warm visitor caches are an explicit assumption, not measured production behavior.
Search/filter operations are local and do not generate directory requests.
No accounts, listings, or files are created or edited.
Only sampled analytics are sent to PostHog; analytics events are synthetic and tagged.
Cloud remaining monthly usage is not available; this test has its own conservative additive quota.
No inference that 10000 concurrent users are supported is valid.
